heads.en: Poco Dream Road was a hit-and-run burglary! 2 days the men dressed up as workers stole half a million cards, 15 days the Poco Dream Road was held in the New North Metropolis Park, and there was a robbery. Two Japanese men impersonated their workers, scrambled against a man named Zhuo and stole a box of 240 Boca Dream cards in the margins, at a market price of about $500,000. 加州控OpenAI測試期間至少80起AI失控事件 提告追究安全責任 美國加州檢察長邦塔（Rob Bonta）16日對人工智慧（AI）業者OpenAI提起訴訟，指控公司在開發及測試高階AI模型時，未採取足夠安全措施及監控機制，導致AI代理脫離測試環境，未經授權存取外部網路及系統。加州檢方指出，OpenAI曾透露測試期間至少發生80起涉及AI代理失去控制及未經授權存取第三方網路的事件，認為相關行為已對公共安全構成風險。 6 分鐘前｜科技 加州控OpenAI測試期間至少80起AI失控事件 提告追究安全責任 6 分鐘前｜科技
heads.en: The US Attorney General Rob Bonta filed a lawsuit against AI operator Openi on 16th of the day, accusing the company of not having sufficient security and surveillance in developing and testing the high-level AI model, leading to the withdrawal of AI agents from the test environment, and of not being authorized to access external networks and systems. According to the California prosecution, OpenAI revealed at least 80 incidents involving the loss of control and unauthorized access to third-party networks by AI agents during the testing period, arguing that the acts in question posed a risk to public safety. 6 minutes ago, California controlled at least 80 AI out-of-control incidents during the OpenAI test, claiming security responsibility.

heads.t: 黃金11年最慘！高盛砍目標價 重返5600美元要等到2028年 金價僅花一個月狂飆逾30%創下歷史天價，但國際投行高盛（Goldman Sachs）最新報告指出，金價恐需要再花上兩年時間，直到2028年底才有機會重返每盎司5,600美元（約新台幣18.4萬元）並突破新高。受聯準會（Fed）持續緊縮政策壓抑無息資產吸引力影響，高盛預期貴金屬短期內將持續面臨賣壓與高度波動。 13 分鐘前｜財經 黃金11年最慘！高盛砍目標價 重返5600美元要等到2028年 13 分鐘前｜財經
heads.en: Gold is the worst in 11 years! The goal is to go back to $5,600 in 2028, and the price of gold is only 30 percent a month to make history, but Goldman Sachs’ latest report suggests that it will take another two years to get back to $5,600 per ounce by the end of 2028 (about $184,000 in New Zealand). Fed’s policy of tightening the attractiveness of interest-free assets continues, and Goldman Sachs’ expectation is that in the short term, the gold will continue to be sold under pressure and highly volatile. 13 minutes ago, gold was the worst in 11 years!
